'''Professor Ishmael Palin''' is a ship Engineer and Thargoid researcher based at '''Abel Laboratory''' in the '''Arque''' system. He is discovered through '''[[Marco Qwent]]''' and provides Grade 5 Thruster engineering and Grade 3 Frame Shift Drive engineering.<ref name="inara-palin">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/3/ Professor Palin — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Palin established an independent research programme devoted to Thargoid technology and later relocated his workshop to Arque. Frontier continues to identify Abel Laboratory as his active facility.<ref name="edwiki-palin">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Ishmael_Palin Ishmael Palin], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="frontier-relics">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/palin-and-ram-tah-seek-unclassified-relics Palin and Ram Tah Seek Unclassified Relics], Frontier Developments, 19 August 3308. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Arque
* '''Facility:''' Abel Laboratory
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules
* '''Referral required:''' [[Marco Qwent]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Palin's direct access conditions are:<ref name="inara-palin" />

# Reach Grade 3 access and progress approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with [[Marco Qwent]].
# Reach a maximum distance of at least '''5,000 light-years from the Commander's career start location'''.
# Obtain '''25 Sensor Fragments'''.
# Provide all 25 fragments at Abel Laboratory.

The distance requirement uses the greatest distance reached from the career start location; it is not a cumulative total of hyperspace travel. Once that maximum-distance statistic reaches 5,000 light-years, returning to the Bubble does not erase the qualification.

Sensor Fragments are Manufactured Engineering materials rather than commodities. They use material storage and do not require 25 tonnes of cargo space.

For route planning, checking the distance statistic, collecting Sensor Fragments, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Professor Palin]].

{{Field note|Marco's referral reveals Palin. The 5,000-light-year qualification and Sensor Fragment contribution remain separate requirements.}}

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Palin increases by:<ref name="inara-palin" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* selling exploration data at Abel Laboratory.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Palin supports. Exploration data gathered while meeting the distance requirement can be sold at Abel Laboratory after access is available. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-palin" />

== Engineering services ==

Palin's maximum grade is specific to each module family.<ref name="inara-palin" /><ref name="edwiki-palin" />

{| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;"
! Module
! Maximum grade
|-
| [[Thrusters]]
| '''Grade 5'''
|-
| [[Frame Shift Drive]]
| '''Grade 3'''
|}

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]]. Palin can apply compatible Experimental Effects to both module families, including to a Frame Shift Drive carrying a higher blueprint grade from another Engineer.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Palin blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed his Grade 5 Thruster or Grade 3 Frame Shift Drive limit, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Referrals ==

Professor Palin does not currently introduce another Engineer in the ship Engineer referral network. His relationship to Marco Qwent, sibling referrals, and other branches can be viewed in the [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
